title: PROP_SUPPORT v1.1.0 — shared support, one NAMED transform authority mode, explicit transfer (v1.0.0 accepted and migrated)
description: Per prop: which hands (of one or several actors) and which fixed surfaces support it, bound to REGISTERED sockets; which ONE of them is the authoritative transform driver in each half-open frame interval. Approved input alongside the PerformanceCommand packet (plan.performance.prop_support). It never contains geometry: sockets come from the measured rigs.

schema_version.description: 1.1.0 (P08 B01) requires authority[].mode; 1.0.0 contracts are migrated (hand driver = OBJECT_DRIVEN, surface = SURFACE_DRIVEN) and reported as migrated

max_step_px.description: largest per-frame prop root travel; more is a teleport

surface_tolerance_px.description: prop base socket to surface target distance allowed while the surface supports it

settle_tolerance_px.description: prop drift allowed while a surface drives it

ref.description: <actor rig>#<hand name of the reviewed role map>

grip_angle_deg.description: required palm basis angle relative to the prop socket's joint (checked every locked frame)

mode.description: ACTOR_DRIVEN: the driver hand's world transform drives the rigid prop (P = H·H_to_P); OBJECT_DRIVEN: the prop's directed track drives it and the driver hand follows by IK (a supporter, never claimed as transform writer); SURFACE_DRIVEN: a fixed or moving registered surface drives it; FREE_AUTHORED: directed free flight on the prop track with no grip support

driver_path.description: ACTOR_DRIVEN only: directed WORLD path of the driver hand socket (and optional world basis angle); the arm is solved to it BEFORE the prop is computed (no hand→prop→hand cycle). Omitted: the driver arm follows its own approved joint tracks (FK).
